name: pijnwerk
title: Pijnwerk
description: Website for the horse coaching company Pijnwerk, including logo and web design.
goal: Create an informative and beautifully modern website where people can learn about this new method of horse coaching and easily get in touch to book sessions.

name: habitica
title: Quest Generator
description: An extension for the productivity app Habitica that uses AI to transform your to-do list items into RPG-style quests.
goal: Enhance productivity by gamifying daily tasks and turning them into RPG-style quests within Habitica.

name: truthfairies
title: Truthfairies INC
description: A website and brand identity for the shamanic coaching company Truth Fairies INC. I helped create the brand identity and coded a proof of concept for a modern, flashy website.
goal: Build a sales funnel through a modern, eye-catching website that attracts new clients and encourages them to reach out for sessions.

name: tapper
title: Coca Cola Tapper
description: A Coca-Cola branded version of the classic arcade game Tapper, created during my time at MBO Utrecht.
goal: Create a game for a fictional Coca-Cola advertising campaign.

name: phunics
title: Phunics Word Game
description: A fun phonics-based word game designed to test and improve children's reading skills, made in collaboration with the American company Phunics. At the end of the game, based on the score, players receive a recommendation for the most suitable course to follow.
goal: Develop a game that the company can use to assess children's reading levels and recommend the best matching course.

name: recoilrampage
title: Recoil Rampage
description: A 2D roguelike shooter where your only way to move is by using your weapon’s recoil. Developed as a creative exercise in game design and development.
